remarks: Welcome to 11841 and 11845 Magnolia Street, a true architectural masterpiece in the heart of Garden Grove—a rare, 2026 custom-built estate offering two brand-new luxury residences on a single lot, totaling ~ 4,219 SQFT of meticulously designed living space. Positioned in a premier school district just steps from vibrant Koreatown, casual dining, and shopping plazas within a short drive, minutes from Bolsa (Phuoc Loc Tho) and Disneyland theme park. This smart-home compound delivers modern luxury and ultimate multi-generational flexibility with fully paid-off solar, separate addresses, and independent utilities for both units.
